_doc: How a run difference (run A minus run B, one product, one grid, one valid time) is coloured. Read by rustwx-render/src/difference.rs. The bar is symmetric about zero with `bands` equal bands; the `neutral_bands` nearest zero take the neutral colour, so a difference smaller than one band reads as no difference. The half range is the table row for the product in the units it is drawn in; with no row, it is the `percentile` of the absolute difference over the cells where the difference is defined, rounded up so one band is a 1, 2 or 5 step. A theme's own `colormaps.diverging` replaces `colors`. Only the filled field is differenced and overlays are dropped, so a product that draws overlays is titled by its filled field: its `titles` row, or else its title up to the first ` / `.
